app.title: Flowchart Generator
app.description: Multi-format industrial flowchart generator (diagnostics, troubleshooting, procedures)

formats.xlsx: Excel: Steps sheet + Transitions sheet, re-importable
formats.pptx: PowerPoint with native editable shapes and connectors
formats.s1000d: S1000D fault isolation data module (Issue 4.x approximation)

editor.title: Editor

preview.title: Preview
preview.emptyHelp: Describe a fault to the assistant or attach a file to display the flowchart.

assistant.welcome: Describe the fault or system to handle (symptom, vehicle, safety constraints), or attach a file (Excel, CSV, DSL, JSON, reference document). I generate a maintenance plan as a flowchart, then you can ask me for live changes.
assistant.placeholder: E.g.: Generate a troubleshooting plan for a truck whose engine does not start, 24 V battery.
assistant.placeholderEdit: Ask for a change: add a starter relay check after the battery...
assistant.thinking: The assistant is working on the flowchart...
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.attachHelp: Attach a flowchart (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .json, .dsl) or a reference document (.txt, .md, .docx, .pdf, .pptx). Drag and drop supported.
assistant.imported: File "{{name}}" imported: {{nodes}} steps. You can now ask me for changes.
assistant.documentAdded: Document "{{name}}" attached. I will use it as a reference to generate or edit the flowchart.
assistant.documentTruncated: Document "{{name}}" attached (truncated: only the beginning is used as reference).

editor.validateHelp: Validate the flowchart to unlock downloads.

data.title: Data
data.emptyHelp: Flowcharts saved from the editor appear here.
data.resetHelp: Deletes all flowcharts. The Mistral configuration is kept.

settings.llmHelp: Disabled: the assistant does not call Mistral; it structures the description line by line and attached files can still be imported.
settings.apiKeyKept: Leave empty to keep the current key

demo.title: Application mode
demo.hint: Demo mode shows fictitious industrial input sets (TELEMAX TH-3500 telehandler) that can be loaded into the assistant. No real data.

demo.pickerHint: Checked files are attached to the assistant and the request is prefilled: review it, then click Send.

hydraulic.title: TH-3500 hydraulic diagnosis
hydraulic.description: Word procedure, Excel maintenance data, PDF HSE instructions and PowerPoint lessons learned about hydraulic pressure loss.
hydraulic.prompt: Generate the TH-3500 hydraulic pressure loss troubleshooting flowchart from the attached documents, including the safety instructions and pressure thresholds.

engineStart.title: TH-3500 engine no-start
engineStart.description: Excel table of engine no-start diagnostic steps, imported directly as a flowchart.
engineStart.prompt: Add a battery isolator check step before the starter test.
